full_page.content:
1935, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 71 Cont.
Nov. 18 Mrs. Ethel Wenz - 36 - T. B.last June - prayed for at that time - then in sanitariam - again in September anxious to get home in time for school. Now home and OK ... promised perpetual Enrollment & weekly Com. as long as she lived - started at once.
18
Louise Stevenson - 33 - operation to be Wed a.m. Nov. 20th - Compli- cation
Loraine Taube - 5 - see 2 pages back
Lucile K. Welch - 35 - Operation for inward goiter 7 weeks ago. Still not OK - Enrolled To-day.
Page 72 Nov. 20 Mrs. Joseph Smith - 42 - going to hospital at 3 P.M. To-day - Opera- tion on threatening tuomer to-morrow at 9 ... She is anxious too about sick daughter & little gr. child.
Mrs. Mary Sytek - 41 - from plains - has husband & 6 children need her - cancer - Drs. in Ann Arbor want to amputate her whole leg. They cut it open in September and it seemed to heal for a few weeks but now has broken out and more painful than ever before. Sent home from Ann Arbor as hopeless.
Wm. Nacey - middle - reconciliation.
1935, December
Page 73 Dec. 4th Robert Flynn of Bay City - prayed for some few months ago when sup- posed to be dying ...... recovered but again quite sick. His mother is not Catholic asks earnestly that we pray.
Fred Schindler + 53 - worked 28 yrs - worried . miraculously saved from instant death by suicide .....
Mrs. Mary Cahil. .... stomach troubles
Mrs. Darga - 42 ....???
Earl Driscoll - 45 about - drinking - breaking mother's heart
Diane Hughbert - 2 - deaf since birth - bright little child but natur- ally cannot speak - except by signs - smiling etc.
